title: Point mass of the correlated pair
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $-1\leq \rho\leq 1$, and let $x,y\in\{−1,1\}^n$. The probability assigned to the pair $(x,y)$ by the correlated-pair distribution equals the uniform probability of $x$ multiplied by the probability that the noise kernel at $x$ assigns to $y$.
